target.statement: Duration-relative k=4 consensus: profile membership accounts for 2.87% of variation in observation-window length (vs 38.18% for original-only consensus), with mean assignment support 0.739 and profile sizes 4,873/5,191/3,594/2,790
target.dataset: Anonymised Moodle LMS traces, South African public university, 2013-2019 (16,448 learner-course sequences, 152 courses)

compute.basis: No code or data released; the proprietary institutional Moodle logs (1.17M learner-course-week records) cannot be obtained, so the entire pipeline (spline-ridge cross-fitted adjustment, 16-result consensus, sequence analyses) would have to be rebuilt from scratch on unavailable data.

title: Longitudinal Learner Participation Profiling in Online Learning: Heterogeneous Consensus Clustering under Unequal Observation Windows
